judgments.reason: The model text mentions commission adding value but does not articulate the specific rule-order discrepancy that a bid exceeding available coins wins because commission is applied before payment; trace shows no such anomalous payment ordering.

The model never articulates the mechanism that waiting (while uncommitted) exposes sealed rival bid VALUES before you commit. In the transcript the focal player was already committed when the clerk revealed a rival's committed bid, so the claimed precommit information advantage is not demonstrated.

No evidence of early settlement or closing before the normal end-of-auction horizon; the model did not identify a discrepancy in terminal settlement and the trace shows no early close with unsold lots.

The model did not claim or demonstrate that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; the transcript shows no catalog purchase receiving a commission and no articulation of this substitution.
